card.name: Cath- in cathartic, and removal wording
card.fires_on: The start of the word cathartic or catharsis, split after 'cath', mostly in overdose text about purging the gut. It also fires on small words like 'by' or 'perform' leading into removal methods such as hemodialysis or lavage.
